name: Keir Legree

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Legree says continuing to manage street homelessness is not good enough and calls for an approach focused on ending it.
positions.excerpt: Continuing to manage street homelessness isn't good enough. We need a new approach focused on ending it.

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Legree says he would dedicate a greater share of the city budget to building and preserving truly affordable housing.
positions.excerpt: By dedicating a greater share of our city budget toward building and preserving truly affordable housing

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Legree says active addiction, serious mental illness and behavioral-health challenges can become major barriers.
positions.excerpt: active addiction, serious mental illness, and behavioral-health challenges can become major barriers

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Legree cites Portland households paying over $2,000 a year in combined water and sewer bills.
positions.excerpt: With Portland households now paying over $2,000 a year in combined water and sewer bills

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Legree says it is time to stop treating families and small businesses as blank checks.
positions.excerpt: it is time to stop treating families and small businesses as blank checks.

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Legree says there have been no reports of anyone getting sick from drinking water since 2017.
positions.excerpt: there have been no reports of anyone getting sick from drinking water since 2017.

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Legree says Portland residents could still conveniently recycle bottles and cans within the city.
positions.excerpt: Portland residents could still conveniently recycle bottles and cans within the city.

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Legree says encampments near schools and youth centers should receive especially urgent attention.
positions.excerpt: Encampments near schools and youth centers should receive especially urgent attention.

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Legree lists predictable scheduling for police, with stable shift patterns to curb forced overtime.
positions.excerpt: Predictable Scheduling: Introduce stable shift patterns to curb forced overtime.

positions.statement: On his campaign site, Legree says that under ranked-choice voting your vote can still count toward your next choice.
positions.excerpt: your vote can still count toward your next choice.
